title: Canonical total-limit realization of one compactification
statement: Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and completed coefficients. For normalized system operations [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and their realization data [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data], a compactification c=(j,p), and an integral constructible object K, define directIdentification from the total limit of the system compact-support word on the reduction of K to the prescribed integral compact-support object. Its factors are the canonical proper/limit conjugate and the open reduction mate of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], the inverse reconstruction unit (inverseOrZero on its isomorphism domain), and the prescribed strict-quotient integral realization [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. This fixes a morphism independently of any composition comparison theorem.
